system.description:
Bullies are common among children. The largest, the loudest, the least fearful of reprisal, often place themselves into positions of power over others through social engineering or outright violence.

Most grow out of it eventually. Feeling bad for the harm they’ve done or at least feigning to in order to avoid the loss of social status that comes with revelation that one was a jerk as a child. Some, however, go on to make a career of it. Use the trouble they cause, and their skill at deflecting blame, as a way to continue to treat others poorly while reaping benefits from them.

Ability Score Increase: Strength or Charisma +1, any other attribute +1

Skill Proficiencies: Deception, Intimidation, expertise in passing blame Deception checks

Tool Proficiencies: None

Suggested Equipment (Cost 15gp): Fine Clothes

Feature: Swaggering Bully. Performance is for prancing dandies. Labor is for suckers and fools. Even fighting for your meal every day has a chance that you’ll lose and go hungry. It’s so much easier to just take what you want from the world, especially when you’re so good at it. In any community with an underclass you’re able to enjoy a moderate lifestyle by verging on violence to get your way, but ever passing the blame to the people who ‘riled you’ and owe you apologies and free service for their actions. You may have to deal with the occasional guard, but a quick smile and an arm around your victim, crushing their shoulder in mock friendliness, is often enough to avoid confrontation.

Adventures and Advancement: While your typical troublemaker has issues advancing, one who lies on their adventuring class can push their free lifestyle up to rich if they get -just- enough social power to begin bullying a higher class of pathetic weaklings.

Connections and Mementos: Roll 1d10, choose, or make up your own.
